sources.purpose: Corroborate which technologies belong to each role; map role aliases to occupations.
sources.preprocessing: Filtered to the SOC codes mapped to curated roles; technology names matched to canonical skills.
sources.limitations: Occupations are coarse (no Frontend/DevOps/MERN occupation). Software lists are long and unranked. Contains NO prerequisites, learning effort, projects or interview topics.

sources.source: ESCO (European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations)
sources.license: NOT VERIFIED in this pipeline: the ESCO download page states only that the data is free of charge. Confirm reuse terms before redistributing ESCO text.
sources.purpose: Corroborate role-to-skill mappings. Not used as training text.
sources.preprocessing: One occupation fetched per curated role; skill titles matched to canonical skills.
sources.limitations: Essential skills are broad competences ('use markup languages'); no prerequisites or learning order.

sources.purpose: Shared vocabulary with the ATS output; source of aliases.
sources.preprocessing: Read-only. Not modified by this pipeline.

sources.real_or_synthetic: real job-description text, synthetic fit labels
sources.purpose: Empirical job demand per skill (share of job descriptions asking for it), via the trained skill recommender.
sources.preprocessing: Read-only reuse of ai-service/artifacts/skill_recommender.json. No text is copied into training data.

sources.purpose: The prerequisite graph, role targets, projects and interview topics no external source provides.
sources.preprocessing: Validated by build_skill_graph.py (acyclic, no dangling references).
sources.limitations: Not an official standard and not empirically validated. Hours are planning estimates.
